skill.summary: Create professional PowerPoint presentations from text prompts using Anthropics' design principles with auto-layout, branding, and image handling.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of PPTX Generator (Anthropics Style).
- Create professional PowerPoint presentations from natural language prompts.
- Supports auto-layouts, brand-consistent design, and smart image placement.
- Export presentations to .pptx or PDF formats.
- Requires python-pptx and Pillow libraries.
